integrity_notes: The standalone checker is included with its direct test output. The proof is algebraic and does not infer the all-field result from finite tests. Dates identify the first available archival preprint and do not represent a publication date for this result.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts ordered labeled commutator fibers only for sl2 over odd finite fields and its first Takiff extension. It does not address characteristic 2, higher Takiff orders, other simple Lie algebras, or pair-orbit classification. Independent mathematical verification and definitive historical priority have not been established.
title: Complete commutator fibers in the finite Takiff Lie algebra of \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\)
